title: Web Portal brand theme (oi-toolkit, skill oneidentity-imx-brand-theme)

id.description: Kebab-case id: theme classes <id>-light-theme and <id>-dark-theme, CSS folder <id>/ in the portal package.

primary.description: Brand color from the brand book (hue 500).

accentNeutral.description: Neutral for light tints and the Material accent. Default: anthracite #5f666d.

accent.description: Single red/brand tone for text, links, icons in the dark theme. Default: computed.

fill.description: Fill with white text in the dark theme. Default: computed.

onBrand.description: Logo for the brand-colored masthead and login (usually white). Path relative to brand.json.

onDark.description: Logo for the dark masthead and login (usually in brand colors).

onLight.description: Logo for a light masthead (layout.lightMasthead = light).

deviceTheme.description: brand: Device theme uses the brand themes.

notes.description: Deviations from the brand book agreed with the customer.
